cd /work && python3 -c "
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np, math
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
im=np.array(Image.open('observations/obs_0102.png').convert('RGB')).astype(int)
R,G,B=im[:,:,0],im[:,:,1],im[:,:,2]
fl=(abs(R-G)<25)&(R>120)&(R<190)&(G>110)&(B>90)&(B<165)&(R-B>15)
tops={}
for u in range(512):
    c=np.nonzero(fl[:,u])[0]
    if len(c): tops[u]=int(c.min())
def bp(u,v):
    D=396.8/(v-256.); return np.array([D*(u-256)/256., D])  # cam-local (right, fwd)
for nm,rng in [('LEFT',range(4,258,4)),('RIGHT',range(370,508,4))]:
    P=np.array([bp(u,tops[u]) for u in rng if u in tops])
    # fit line, get perpendicular distance from camera origin + direction
    c=P.mean(0); A=P-c; _,_,V=np.linalg.svd(A); d=V[0]; n=np.array([-d[1],d[0]])
    dist=abs(n@c); res=np.abs(A@n)
    ang=math.degrees(math.atan2(d[0],d[1]))
    print(nm,'perp_dist=%.3f m  line_dir_ang=%.2f  rms=%.4f m n=%d'%(dist,ang,res.std(),len(P)))
" 2>/dev/null
